quality_reference: Native Platinum/HGSS DS battle sprites: silhouette readability, restrained palette, coherent front/back design, clean outline, and 80x80 framing.

entries.name: abyssand
entries.note: Strong front/back silhouette and DS readability; back is much darker than front, so palette/contrast needs a consistency pass.

entries.name: amphybuzz
entries.note: Crisp outline, readable silhouette, coherent design and palette across front/back at DS scale.

entries.name: arachtres
entries.note: Good silhouette and detail density, but front is much warmer/brighter than back; palette harmonization needed.

entries.name: arashinne
entries.note: Front/back palette and material treatment diverge too much (gold front vs brown back); needs matched-pair correction.

entries.name: bariong
entries.note: Strong readable design, but front/back value balance and white/teal treatment differ enough to warrant cleanup.

entries.name: beefender
entries.note: Front and back read as different palette interpretations; needs matched palette and shading treatment.

entries.name: beniccino
entries.note: Front is dark/purple while back is pale/cream; pair is not visually coherent enough for approval.

entries.name: bewarden
entries.note: Design matches, but front/back gray/black values differ; small palette consistency pass should fix it.

entries.name: blizzard_maw
entries.note: Already flagged palette-quantized; white front and dark back are too inconsistent for DS-quality approval.

entries.name: blocli
entries.note: Simple geometric form reads cleanly at DS scale and front/back presentation is coherent.

entries.name: bloxtack
entries.note: Clean, readable block silhouette and consistent palette logic across front/back.

entries.name: boarlock
entries.note: Strong DS-style silhouette and coherent front/back palette; ready for approval review.

entries.name: breezing
entries.note: Readable and coherent, but front/back saturation and highlight treatment need a small cleanup pass.

entries.name: brontonana
entries.note: Good silhouette and anatomy; orange/green front vs darker green/brown back needs palette harmonization.

entries.name: bubbleo
entries.note: Front is blue/white while back is brown/yellow; matched-pair palette correction required.

entries.name: cacjack
entries.note: Front uses neon red/orange/green while back is near-black; pair fails front/back consistency.

entries.name: carbonix
entries.note: Front is pale/cream while back is dark blue/black; likely mismatched conversion/palette source.

entries.name: castform_foggy
entries.note: Form reads well and pose is DS-friendly; front/back value balance differs but is recoverable.

entries.name: castform_sandy
entries.note: Front/back form, palette family, and scale are coherent; good approval candidate.

entries.name: chesnaught_clemont
entries.note: Front/back colors are radically inconsistent (blue/white vs green); needs source recovery or palette reconstruction.

entries.name: clodsire_mega
entries.note: Visible candidate is strong but needs complete pair/asset verification before approval.
